title: Divergence: build::build_file + body_tv (+exec_tv) bypass the #193 open-hole validator — a holed fn lowers with the hole silently dropped (forge build emits an artifact, body-tv reports faithful)

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Failing tests at forge/tests/divergence_holed_lowering.rs::{divergence_build_emits_artifact_for_holed_item, divergence_body_tv_reports_holed_body_faithful} demonstrate the divergence. Root cause: only check::check_file_with_options consults FnItem.holes; because a hole is NOT a Stmt variant, every other lowering path (build::build_file front, body_tv, exec_tv corpus mode) lowers the hole-stripped body — the open goal vanishes into a valid program. Observed: forge build on 'fn main { ?0  42 }' emits an rlib + 'assurance: L1' manifest, exit 0; body-tv reports 'main — faithful'. Authority: goal-repl.md REQ-4/REQ-5 (no lowering, no verus; L0-equivalent until every hole is filled), ast.rs FnItem.holes contract ('a holed item never lowers'), thermite-design.md §6 (the build manifest is the trust statement).

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Critic pin plan: commit forge/tests/divergence_holed_lowering.rs with two un-ignored failing tests asserting the authority's behavior (a holed item never lowers: forge build must refuse, body-tv must not certify faithful). The failing tests ARE the block; the generator must route every lowering path through the open-hole validator.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: FIXED + re-critic-clean (d2d1d445). One shared open_hole_reason helper gates build (refusal, no artifact) + body-tv/exec-tv (Skipped OpenHole, never Faithful) + check (refactor byte-identical); gates fire pre-lowering; no over-gate (hole-free corpus green); 3 pins pass live unchanged-as-oracle.
